title: Flourless Walnut Cake
description: A light-as-a-feather sponge using ground walnuts instead of flour and icing sugar instead of caster sugar for a cloud-like texture.

ingredients.text: 250g icing sugar, plus extra to decorate

steps: Preheat the oven to 210°C/190°C fan. Grease and line a 23cm round cake tin.
Separate out 30g walnuts and set aside. Blitz the rest in a blender to fine crumbs.
Separate the eggs. Beat the icing sugar and yolks together until light and fluffy (10 minutes by hand, 3–4 minutes with electric whisk). Stir in the ground walnuts.
Whisk the egg whites to soft peaks. Fold the whites into the sugar and yolk mixture a little at a time with a metal spoon.
Pour the batter into the lined tin. Bake for 35 minutes until a skewer comes out clean.
Allow to cool, then sift icing sugar over the top and top with the reserved walnuts, chopped.
notes: Serves 10. Serve with freshly whipped cream.
